title: A Promise Made Together
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Josiah gathered everyone
And read God’s words out loud,
Then made a promise to the Lord
In front of all the crowd.

[Chorus]
I’ll keep my promises to God,
To love Him and obey,
For keeping promises to Him
Will make me strong each day.

[Verse 2]
The people stood and promised too,
They cleaned the idols out,
Then held a happy holy day
And gave a joyful shout.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes and softly say
The promise in your heart,
“I’ll love You, Lord, and follow You,”
And God will do His part.

[Chorus]
mood: Gathering music. A warm, steady rocking sway moves under the voice like a crowd standing up together to make one promise, simple and sure, matching Josiah leading all the people back to God. The chorus is the promise itself, sung plainly and a little fuller each time. By the last verse the sway grows slower and lower, the crowd fades to a single quiet voice, and the song rests on a soft, settled ending.
